Old Tomas walked his usual route around the rocks below the lighthouse, half-watching the gulls wheel overhead. That was when he saw it: a green bottle wedged between two stones, its cork sealed with wax. Inside was a scrap of paper, water-stained but legible. The handwriting was a child's, uneven and earnest. Tomas sat on the rocks for a long while, turning the paper over in his hands, before tucking it into his coat pocket and walking back up to the light.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯还亮着，橘黄色的光洒在空荡的街道上，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车轮碾过积水的声音格外清晰。便利店的玻璃窗里透出一点微弱的灯光，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处传来清洁车缓慢清扫的声响，混合着鸟儿尚未开始鸣叫的寂静。高楼的轮廓在灰蓝色的天空下显得格外沉默，像是巨人在沉睡。偶尔有一盏窗户亮着，不知是谁还未入睡，或是已经早早起身。整座城市仿佛在喘息，积蓄着白天的喧嚣之前，最后一点属于自己的安静时光。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by calling itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\nEach time it calls itself, the problem gets a little smaller, like opening nested boxes until you reach the tiniest one.\nThere has to be a stopping point, called a base case, or the function would keep calling itself forever."}
